app.title: Show HN: Live map of U.S. flights during tonight's FAA nationwide ground stop
app.description: Real‑time map visualizing U.S. flight movements during FAA ground stops, powered by live ADS‑B data.

Subscribe to a flight feed and confirm a flight marker appears
Simulate a ground stop event and check that flight count drops to zero
